plan.text: Establish the diamond suit for tricks while preserving dummy’s heart ace as an entry. After winning the spade lead with the king, play a low diamond from dummy toward declarer’s D5432; use declarer’s D5 if East follows low, then return to dummy’s diamonds when possible. Keep the heart honors as stoppers and entries; reassess based on the defenders’ discards and diamond split.
